errors.evidence: This description incorrectly simplifies the grey line's trajectory to fit the hallucinated five-year period. The actual line has several fluctuations before its major increase, which are not captured. For example, it starts around 25,000, goes up to ~40,000, down to ~25,000, up to ~35,000, down to ~28,000, and then begins its steep climb.

errors.evidence: This description misrepresents the blue line. It does not start at zero; it starts at approximately 30,000. It then decreases to near zero before beginning its steep rise. The description omits this initial high value and subsequent drop.

The legend entry for the blue line is "Създаване и разпространение на информация и творчески продукти; далекосъобщения". The description incorrectly replaces "далекосъобщения" (telecommunications) with "дистрибуция" (distribution).
